task: Validate ASCII-only trimming against a non-breaking-space control case.
observation: A Moss string literal using the documented-style \u00a0 escape passed checking, but generated Rust retained the non-Rust escape spelling and failed compilation.
impact: The native package test required an extra diagnosis and source-preserving workaround before the Unicode boundary case could run.

resolution.summary: Use the literal non-breaking-space code point in the permanent regression test; the SDK contract is unchanged.
